title: shadcn-ui/cn
why_read: A drop-in, significantly faster replacement for the widely-used tailwind-merge/clsx combo that many frontend projects depend on for class-name handling.
analysis: This is a new Tailwind CSS class-merging engine claiming full API parity with tailwind-merge and clsx but 30x faster performance, which matters because these utilities run on every render in many React/Tailwind codebases and are called extremely frequently. Given shadcn/ui's broad adoption in the React ecosystem, a faster drop-in replacement could have real-world performance impact on many production frontends. It's a narrow but concrete and immediately actionable optimization for frontend engineers using Tailwind.
